info.title: pnfmt
info.description: Format C# source, XML, XAML, .NET project, solution, resource, response, and configuration files.

options.name: --all
options.description: Process all files in scope instead of only Git changes.

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Recurse into subdirectories when a path is a directory.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed per-file logging and errors.

options.name: -maxCpuCount
options.description: Process up to N files concurrently; omit N to use all CPUs.

options.name: --file-pattern
options.description: Include only files matching the glob; repeat to include more.

options.name: --formatter
options.description:
Run only the named formatters; repeat or use comma-separated names.
Available names: csharp, csproj, ini, resx, rsp, slnx, xaml, xml.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would change without writing files.

options.name: --check
options.description: Exit with code 1 if any file would change (implies --dry-run).

options.name: --lint
options.description: Report formatter diagnostics and formatting changes; exit 1 if found.

options.name: --migrate-legacy-config
options.description: Import legacy formatter settings using current names.

options.name: --remove-legacy-config
options.description: Remove legacy settings after optional migration.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version info.
Notes:
If no path is provided, the current directory is used.
maxCpuCount defaults to the repository .pnfmt value, or 1.
Registered formatters support .cs, .csproj, .editorconfig, .ini, .resx, .rsp, .slnx, .xaml, .xml files.
Set pnfmt_enabled = true and pnfmt_formatter = <name> in .editorconfig to enable processing.
pnfmt_enabled = false skips all processing, including lint; formatter None also skips it.
pnfmt_format controls layout (default true); sorting and cleanup require their own switches.
Missing enablement or selection retains compatibility behavior with warning PNFMT004.
A future version will require explicit enablement and formatter selection.
--formatter filters the selected formatters; it does not override EditorConfig activation.
Shared settings use pnfmt_; format-specific settings add the formatter name.
Legacy formatter settings remain fallbacks and produce warnings.
